game_title: Function Test Arena – Snow Fort Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing yeti raiders.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing yeti raiders. Each round, a new firewood challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of firewood by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Snow Fort'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 300 within 45 seconds.
